fullDescription: A light, Apple-Shop-style product-card carousel: a horizontal scroll-snap track of tall white kit cards (the first highlighted with a 'New' badge + cobalt ring + lift, the next peeking past the right edge), circular prev/next arrows, color-swatch dots, and a thin cobalt progress bar with an 01/06 counter, all on near-white surfaces with a single cobalt-blue accent and Inter type.
prompt:
## Resumo
A light, premium product page for an AI design agent's design-hardware brand ('LumenStudio'), anchored by an Apple-Shop-style PRODUCT-CARD CAROUSEL: a horizontal, scroll-snapping track of tall white kit cards, the first card highlighted (a 'New' badge, a cobalt ring, and a stronger lifted shadow) and a fourth card peeking in from the right edge to signal more. Each card carries an oversized extrabold product name, a soft tinted radial 'grain' tile holding a stylized device mock, a row of color-swatch dots, a one-line descriptor, and a 'From $price / kit' + Buy footer split by a hairline. Sections (a sticky blurred nav, a full-bleed hero strip 'All kits. Take your pick.', the carousel section with a header row + circular prev/next arrows + a thin progress bar with an 01/06 counter, and a full-bleed shipping/compare footer strip) all sit inside a centered max-w-[1180px] column and reflow to a draggable single-row track on mobile.

## Estilo Visual
Design a light, premium, Apple-store-like commerce UI. Palette EXACTLY: page background paper #f8fafc with pure-white #ffffff cards and nav; text ink #0b1220 (near-black navy) for headings and 'slatey' #475569 for body/secondary/nav links; single accent cobalt-blue with cobalt-500 #2563eb as the primary, cobalt-600 #1d4ed8 as hover, cobalt-700 #1e40af as the deep stop in gradients, and tints cobalt-50 #eff4ff and cobalt-100 #dbe6ff for badges, rings, and active-card backgrounds. Reserve playful secondary product hues (sky-100/300, violet-200/300, emerald-200/300/400/500, orange-400) ONLY for the per-card device mocks and the small color-swatch dots, never on nav/buttons/chrome. Font: Inter for everything (weights 400-900) with -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased. Headings are font-extrabold, tracking-[-0.02em]/[-0.01em], leading ~1.05-1.12; the eyebrow is an 11px uppercase font-bold cobalt-600 label with letter-spacing 0.16em; body is 12-14.5px leading-relaxed/snug slatey. Shadows are soft and large, never hard: card = 0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,.04), 0 12px 30px -12px rgba(15,23,42,.18); cardhi = 0 2px 4px rgba(15,23,42,.06), 0 28px 50px -18px rgba(37,99,235,.30) (a cobalt-tinted lift on the highlighted first card); nav = 0 1px 0 rgba(15,23,42,.06); pill = 0 6px 18px -6px rgba(37,99,235,.55) on cobalt buttons; and a device filter drop-shadow(0 26px 30px rgba(15,23,42,.18)). Hairline borders are slate-200; the active card adds ring-1 ring-cobalt-100. Corners are generously rounded: rounded-full pills/badges/arrows, rounded-[26px] cards, rounded-[20px] device tiles, rounded-[9px]/[14px]/[18px] device bodies. Add soft radial 'grain' tiles behind the device mocks and the hero: e.g. radial-gradient(120% 90% at 18% 8%, #ffffff 0%, #f4f8ff 42%, #eaf0fb 100%) and sibling variants at 82%/12% and 50%/6%. Tone: quiet, confident, premium retail. Icons exclusively Iconify Phosphor 'fill'/'bold' weight (e.g. ph:sparkle-fill, ph:squares-four-fill, ph:caret-left-bold, ph:caret-right-bold, ph:hand-grabbing-fill, ph:truck-fill, ph:arrow-right-bold).

## Layout e Estrutura

### Sticky nav
Sticky top header (z-50), 60px tall, paper/85 (#f8fafc at 85%) background with backdrop-blur-md and the named 'nav' bottom-hairline shadow (0 1px 0 rgba(15,23,42,.06)); contents inside the centered max-w-[1180px] column with px-6 gutters, as a flex row items-center justify-between. Left: a 7x7 rounded-[9px] cobalt-500 #2563eb tile carrying the 'pill' glow and a white 16px ph:sparkle-fill icon, beside a 15px font-extrabold tracking-tight wordmark 'Lumen' + a cobalt-600 #1d4ed8 'Studio'. Center (md+ only): five 13.5px font-medium slatey #475569 links (All Kits [active, ink #0b1220], Workflows, Pricing, Showcase, Docs) that darken to ink on hover. Right: an sm-only 13.5px font-semibold slatey 'Sign in' text link and a primary pill button 'Start free' (rounded-full, cobalt-500 fill, white 13px font-semibold, 'pill' glow, hover:bg-cobalt-600).

### Hero strip
A full-bleed white section with a slate-200/70 bottom border and a relative overflow-hidden body; behind it a soft radial 'grain-3' tile (radial-gradient(120% 90% at 50% 6%, #ffffff 0%, #eef4ff 50%, #e3ecfd 100%)) at opacity-70. Content inside the centered max-w-[1180px] column, pt-12 pb-7: first a cobalt-600 #1d4ed8 row = a 14px ph:squares-four-fill icon + an 11px uppercase font-bold eyebrow with letter-spacing 0.16em reading 'Studio Kits 2026'; then a mt-3 flex (col -> md:row, md:items-end md:justify-between): left = an extrabold tracking-[-0.02em] h1 up to max-w-[640px], leading-[1.05], 34px -> md:44px, reading 'All kits.' in ink #0b1220 then 'Take your pick.' in slatey #475569; right = a max-w-[360px] 14.5px leading-relaxed slatey sub 'Modular design hardware for the infinite canvas. Pick a kit, ship UI faster.'

### Carousel section (the anchor)
The centerpiece, on the paper #f8fafc background, inside the centered max-w-[1180px] column (py-10). HEADER ROW (mb-6, flex items-end justify-between): left = a 20px font-bold tracking-tight 'Featured kits' over a mt-1 13px slatey sub 'Six builds, one canvas. Drag, or use the arrows.'; right = a flex gap-3 cluster: an sm+ only rounded-full slate-200-bordered white chip 'drag to explore' with a 13px cobalt-500 ph:hand-grabbing-fill icon, a quiet prev arrow (10x10 rounded-full, white, slate-200 border, slate-400 ph:caret-left-bold, shadow-sm), and a primary next arrow (10x10 rounded-full, cobalt-500 fill, white ph:caret-right-bold, 'pill' glow, hover:cobalt-600). TRACK: a relative wrapper holding a flex gap-5 overflow-x-auto track with scroll-snap-type x mandatory, a hidden scrollbar, pb-2 and pr-10 so the next card peeks. Render four tall PRODUCT CARDS (see component spec), the first highlighted, the fourth peeking past the right gutter. PROGRESS BAR (mt-6, flex items-center gap-4): an h-1.5 flex-1 rounded-full slate-200 track with an absolute 42%-wide cobalt-500 fill, then a 12px font-medium slatey counter '01 / 06' with the '01' in bold ink.

### Product card
A scroll-snap-start article, w-[300px] shrink-0, flex flex-col, rounded-[26px] white bg, p-6. The HIGHLIGHTED first card uses the 'cardhi' cobalt-tinted lift shadow + ring-1 ring-cobalt-100 and an absolute top-5 right-5 rounded-full cobalt-50 px-2.5 py-1 10px font-bold uppercase 'New' badge in cobalt-600; the rest use the softer 'card' shadow + ring-1 ring-slate-200/60. Top: a 21px font-extrabold leading-[1.12] tracking-[-0.01em] product name (e.g. 'Lumen Pro & Pro Max', 'Lumen Air', 'Lumen Core', 'Lumen Mini'). Then a mt-5 h-[200px] grid place-items-center rounded-[20px] soft radial 'grain' tile (rotate the grain-1/2/3 variants per card) holding a 'device' mock floated by a drop-shadow(0 26px 30px rgba(15,23,42,.18)) filter: a stylized phone/panel built from rounded gradient rects (e.g. a cobalt-500 -> cobalt-700 body with white/25 app-dots beside a slate-900 -> slate-700 mini body for the Pro; a sky-100 -> sky-300 panel with white app dots + line rows for Air; a violet-200 -> cobalt-100 body with a centered ph:flower-lotus-fill for Core; emerald-200 -> emerald-400 + a small emerald-500 module for Mini). Then a mt-5 row of h-3 w-3 rounded-full color-SWATCH dots (the active one ring-2 in its tint, e.g. cobalt-500 ring-cobalt-100), a mt-3 12px leading-snug slatey one-line descriptor, and a mt-4 border-t border-slate-100 pt-5 footer (flex items-end justify-between): left = a 12px slatey 'From' over a 16px font-bold '$1,099' + a 12px font-medium slatey '/ kit'; right = a Buy button (rounded-full px-5 py-2.5 13px font-semibold) that is a solid cobalt-500 fill + white + 'pill' glow on the highlighted card and an outline (border-cobalt-500, cobalt-600 text, hover:bg-cobalt-50) on the rest.

### Footer strip
A full-bleed white section with a slate-200 top border; contents in the centered max-w-[1180px] column (py-7), flex (col -> sm:row) items-center justify-between gap-4: left = a 13px slatey row with a 16px cobalt-500 ph:truck-fill icon reading 'Free 2-day shipping on every kit. 30-day returns.'; right = a 13px font-semibold cobalt-600 link 'Compare all kits' with a 14px ph:arrow-right-bold icon.

## Componentes Especiais de UI

### Componente
Apple-Shop-style product-card carousel: a horizontal scroll-snap-type-x-mandatory track (gap-5, hidden scrollbar, pr-10 so the next card peeks) of tall w-[300px] rounded-[26px] white cards; the first card is highlighted with a 'New' badge, a ring-1 ring-cobalt-100, and a cobalt-tinted 'cardhi' lift shadow, the fourth peeks in from the right edge to signal more.

### Componente
Highlighted-vs-resting card system: the active card carries the 'cardhi' shadow (0 28px 50px -18px rgba(37,99,235,.30)) + ring-cobalt-100 + a solid cobalt Buy button, while resting cards use the softer 'card' shadow + ring-slate-200/60 + an outline (cobalt-border) Buy button.

### Componente
Soft radial 'grain' device tiles: each card's mock sits on a rounded-[20px] radial-gradient tile (white -> faint blue/slate, rotated per card: 18%/8%, 82%/12%, 50%/6%) with the device floated by a drop-shadow(0 26px 30px rgba(15,23,42,.18)) filter.

### Componente
Stylized device mocks built purely from CSS: rounded gradient rects + white/opacity app-dots, line rows, and a centered Phosphor glyph form per-product phones/panels (a dual-module cobalt+slate Pro rig, a sky panel, a violet 'Core' with a lotus, an emerald Mini).

### Componente
Color-swatch dot rows: a row of h-3 w-3 rounded-full dots in the card's product hues, the active swatch carrying a ring-2 in its own tint (e.g. cobalt-500 ring-cobalt-100).

### Componente
Circular carousel controls: a quiet prev arrow (white, slate-200 border, slate-400 ph:caret-left-bold, shadow-sm) paired with a primary next arrow (cobalt-500 fill, white ph:caret-right-bold, 'pill' glow, hover:cobalt-600), plus an sm+ 'drag to explore' chip with a ph:hand-grabbing-fill icon.

### Componente
Thin progress bar + counter: an h-1.5 rounded-full slate-200 track with a 42%-wide cobalt-500 fill, beside a '01 / 06' counter whose '01' is bold ink.

### Componente
Soft shadow + glow system (never hard): named card / cardhi / nav shadows plus a cobalt 'pill' glow (0 6px 18px -6px rgba(37,99,235,.55)) on every cobalt button and the next arrow.

### Componente
Full-bleed hero + footer strips: a white hero strip with a soft radial grain behind a big two-tone 'All kits. Take your pick.' headline, and a white footer strip pairing a ph:truck-fill shipping line with a 'Compare all kits' arrow link.

### Componente
Single cobalt accent on chrome with playful per-card product hues: cobalt-500 #2563eb is the only chrome accent (logo, buttons, next arrow, active ring, progress), while sky/violet/emerald/orange live only inside the device mocks and swatch dots.

## Notas Especiais
The whole point is a PREMIUM RETAIL CAROUSEL in the Apple-Shop idiom: light paper (#f8fafc) + white surfaces, near-black navy ink (#0b1220) headings, slatey (#475569) body, and a single cobalt-blue accent (cobalt-500 #2563eb) reserved for chrome intent (the logo tile, the primary buttons, the next arrow, the highlighted card's ring, and the progress fill). Depth comes only from large SOFT shadows + a cobalt-tinted lift on the active card (the named card / cardhi / nav shadows and a cobalt 'pill' glow), never hard offset blocks; corners are generously rounded everywhere. The carousel reads as a real store: a horizontal scroll-snap track where the first card is clearly the hero pick (a 'New' badge, a cobalt ring, the strongest lift, and a solid cobalt Buy) and a fourth card deliberately peeks past the right gutter to invite a drag/scroll, with quiet circular arrows + a 'drag to explore' chip + a 42% progress bar and 01/06 counter doing the wayfinding. Playful secondary product hues (sky, violet, emerald, orange-400) are quarantined to the per-card device mocks and swatch dots so the chrome stays single-accent. Inter is the only typeface (400-900); the eyebrow is 11px uppercase with 0.16em tracking in cobalt-600; headings are extrabold tracking-tight. Icons are exclusively Iconify Phosphor 'fill'/'bold' weight. Built with Tailwind (CDN) using a custom cobalt scale + ink/slatey/paper tokens and the named shadows card / cardhi / nav / pill; the soft radial 'grain' tiles, the hidden-scrollbar snap track, and the device drop-shadow are defined in a small <style> block.

structured.special_notes: The whole point is a PREMIUM RETAIL CAROUSEL in the Apple-Shop idiom: light paper (#f8fafc) + white surfaces, near-black navy ink (#0b1220) headings, slatey (#475569) body, and a single cobalt-blue accent (cobalt-500 #2563eb) reserved for chrome intent (the logo tile, the primary buttons, the next arrow, the highlighted card's ring, and the progress fill). Depth comes only from large SOFT shadows + a cobalt-tinted lift on the active card (the named card / cardhi / nav shadows and a cobalt 'pill' glow), never hard offset blocks; corners are generously rounded everywhere. The carousel reads as a real store: a horizontal scroll-snap track where the first card is clearly the hero pick (a 'New' badge, a cobalt ring, the strongest lift, and a solid cobalt Buy) and a fourth card deliberately peeks past the right gutter to invite a drag/scroll, with quiet circular arrows + a 'drag to explore' chip + a 42% progress bar and 01/06 counter doing the wayfinding. Playful secondary product hues (sky, violet, emerald, orange-400) are quarantined to the per-card device mocks and swatch dots so the chrome stays single-accent. Inter is the only typeface (400-900); the eyebrow is 11px uppercase with 0.16em tracking in cobalt-600; headings are extrabold tracking-tight. Icons are exclusively Iconify Phosphor 'fill'/'bold' weight. Built with Tailwind (CDN) using a custom cobalt scale + ink/slatey/paper tokens and the named shadows card / cardhi / nav / pill; the soft radial 'grain' tiles, the hidden-scrollbar snap track, and the device drop-shadow are defined in a small <style> block.
